checkpoint_strategy: Atomic partial_results.jsonl rewrite every 12 completed rows; each cell is independently resumable.
chunk_strategy: One weight-by-membrane cell per process; batches of four active episodes; only one model or adapter loaded at a time.
abort_semantics: A timeout, cap breach, swap, competing GPU process, malformed universe, or incomplete cell is preserved as a valid structured abort and prevents later cells.
cleanup: Each cell releases model, adapter, tokenizer, tensors, and CUDA cache; the wrapper terminates only the recorded current process group and fails if a GPU compute application remains.
